user.title: Connect Mansion Security
user.description: Choose a sign-in method. Keep the phone app signed out because the service allows one login.

menu_options.login: Sign in with username and password

reauth.title: Reauthenticate Mansion Security
reauth.description: Sign in with the same account or import a completed session.

menu_options.login: Sign in with username and password

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your Mansion Security user ID and current password. The service will be checked for any pairing or initialization requirements.

pairing.title: Enter the intercom pairing code
pairing.description: Paste the complete decoded string from the intercom's QR label. No camera or image upload is needed. The nickname is used if initialization is required. Read the [app's notice](https://scmresource-prod.10fw.jp/contracttext.html).

data.accept_terms: I have read the notice and agree to use this account with HA

initialize.title: Complete required password initialization
initialize.description: The service has not activated this login after pairing. This step actually changes the account password, following the native app's registration. Choose 8–32 printable ASCII characters, without spaces, different from your current password. Keep the new password. HA does not store passwords or change them during normal operation or restarts.

finish_registration.title: Finish registration
finish_registration.description: The initialization request has been sent. Submit to retry only pairing and reading; the password change will not be repeated. If the earlier request timed out, its outcome is uncertain. If this keeps failing, close this flow and sign in using the currently valid password.

import_session.title: Import an existing session
import_session.description: Paste the complete private code starting with MSHA1. This verifies an existing session without a new login or password change.

reauth_confirm.title: Import a new session
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a new private session code for the same account.

error.invalid_session: The session code is malformed or belongs to another account.
error.invalid_auth: The credentials or session were rejected. Check the account and currently valid password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Mansion Security. Try again later.
error.already_logged_in: The service returned alreadyLoggedIn. Sign out normally from the phone app before trying again.
error.wrong_account: Use the account already configured for this integration.
error.invalid_pairing_code: Enter the complete QR string without newlines or control characters.
error.terms_required: Read and accept the notice first.
error.pairing_failed: The pairing or device registration was rejected. Check the QR code and account binding.
error.password_mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
error.password_unchanged: The service requires a different password for initialization.
error.invalid_password: Use 8–32 printable ASCII characters without spaces.
error.initialization_failed: Password and nickname initialization was rejected. Check the rules and account state.
error.initialization_uncertain: Initialization is unconfirmed and was not repeated. Retry the remaining registration or sign in again with the currently valid password.

abort.wrong_account: The session belongs to another account.

authentication_required.message: The session requires authentication. Update it from the integration settings.

cannot_set_mode.message: The requested mode was not confirmed. Check the connection and current server state before trying again.

invalid_option.message: This preset is not available for persistent automatic response.
